summary: fetchAllWebsites paginates past 200 sites; snapshotMetrics writes each (day, metric_type) pair in one transaction and drains the metrics dimension with limit/offset pagination so busy days are stored completely.
reason: Greptile review findings on PR #1458 (rounds 1-2): single-page site listing dropped sites beyond 200; partially-written metric days were frozen as complete; top-200-capped metric responses permanently truncated busy days.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test green; live: portfolio returns all 18 sites, snapshot idempotent, no partial or capped history.
